items.title: How reading speed changes when a rushed reader actually reaches the ask
items.description: Drag the reader's reading speed and see how many seconds it takes to reach Jordan's ask in the original narrative-first draft (148 words of setup first) versus the BLUF rewrite (the ask is inside the 79-word opening itself). At any reading speed, BLUF gets the reader to the ask in roughly half the time.
items.compute: const secondsToAskNarrative = Math.round((148 / params.readingSpeedWpm) * 60 * 10) / 10; const secondsToAskBLUF = Math.round((79 / params.readingSpeedWpm) * 60 * 10) / 10; return { secondsToAskNarrative, secondsToAskBLUF };
